llm.brief: Daily close-to-close bars for a few dozen large USDT spot pairs on one crypto exchange. There are no industries: every pair is in one group, so the industry operators act on the whole cross-section. The portfolio is dollar-neutral, rebalanced daily on data through the previous day, and pays 10 bps per side, so turnover is expensive. Look for cross-sectional signals such as short- and medium-horizon momentum or reversal, volatility, volume and trading-range effects. Prefer simple, low-turnover expressions.
